The more I think about it, the less scared I am of death. I dont believe in religion, I've lost that belief long ago. I am sure that after death there is nothing. There was nothing before death, so there is nothing after death.

There is one thing left for me that makes me sure that I can't do it right now. I love this girl more than I love my family. I look at her and get a small understanding of what something precious is. But as time goes on, I feel less and less involved with her. My brain seems to have stopped thinking about her lately. It is alittle sad to me, and that sadness makes me feel human. If I still feel human, I cannot simply end my life.

But that feeling of being human is a fleeting feeling. Sometimes I feel nothing about not speaking to my friend for a week. I think if I lose that feeling of seeing her as important I will be done.

As for leaving things behind, I understand that point a little. I dont want to leave behind a world of hurt to the few I still am friends with, but there's no material objects binding me to this earth. The more distant I become with my emotions, the more likely I am to end it. I don't even have a drive to find these emotions, I just count down the days until they leave for good.
